scope: GSM8K official TRAIN-FIT source-reference label pilot; not inference accuracy

rows.reason: Research plus editing minutes are converted using 60 minutes/hour; pages times minutes/page is separately converted and added. The original graph normalizes the stated one-page numerator; arbitrary changes to that numerator are outside this fixed-graph review.
Each service price is paired with its own car count. The two occurrences of 5 mean oil-change count and car-wash price; neither replaces the other. Three computed revenues are summed.
Daily hours times days/week yields weekly hours; computed weekly hours times weeks yields total hours.

Each coin count pairs with its own penny conversion. Both complete programs differ only by directly swapping dime count and dime value at multiplication; nickel sources and summed revenues remain correct.
Monday and Friday counts are added; triple licenses constant 3 applied to Monday count. The two distinct computed subtotals are summed.
Required rejection: five products imply four between-product waits, while application durations are unstated. The supplied five-times-five rationale does not justify 55 minutes.
Required rejection: the final divisor 5 is a derived count of two white plus three red houses. No original node computes it; substituting constant 5 misrepresents a variable subtotal.
Area divided by coverage yields paint volume; two coats and an ordinary equal cost split between two people justify the two constant-2 operations. Computed volume multiplies the stated price.

The three activity durations are added through original nested nodes; the movie duration is input 3 rather than the equal-valued reading-plus-dinner subtree. Subtract total occupied time from travel duration.
Richmond population minus its excess yields Victoria population; dividing this computed population by the stated factor gives Beacon population.
All 30 children including Katie each get two bars; computed bar count divides by box capacity. Original count is divisible; this graph does not claim general ceiling division for arbitrary counts.
Amy age plus the older-age gap yields current Mark age; add future elapsed years to this computed age.
Existing caterpillars plus newly hatched caterpillars minus those leaving. Ordinary one-caterpillar-per-egg reading is justified by the problem.

Calories per chip divide total calories by chip count. One-third more adds a computed one-third increment to that base. The separate six-cheezit input multiplies the result; original chip calories are added. The original graph normalizes the unit-fraction numerator; arbitrary numerator changes are outside this fixed graph.
Both per-mile times multiply the same distance; accompanied elapsed time minus solo elapsed time yields extra minutes.
Distance divided by elapsed hours yields hourly speed; computed speed times the new duration yields distance.

Driving distance divides by speed. Lunch minutes plus two repetitions of the stated bathroom-break duration yield break minutes, then constant 60 converts to hours. Add both computed durations. Two breaks are structurally unrolled in the fixed graph; arbitrary changes to break count require another graph.

Correct rejection: six bike/trash-can wheels are derived by an unannotated 3*2 calculation missing from supplied nodes. Constant 6 would conceal this missing dependency; conventional wheel counts alone cannot fix the supplied graph.

Lemonade price and count use separate equal-valued occurrences, with two correlated direct-multiplication swaps. Sandwich price pairs with sandwich count. Combined costs are subtracted from the payment bill.
Future height minus current height yields annual growth; constant 12 months/year converts this computed difference to monthly growth.
Wallet balance plus father transfer yields subtotal. Twice licenses constant 2 multiplying the father transfer. Computed mother transfer and earlier subtotal are summed.

Quarts multiply the explicit cups/quart occurrence. Reduction preserves multiply-by-fraction-numerator then divide-by-denominator nodes. Sugar input 1 is distinct from reduction numerator 1 and added to computed reduced volume.
Thrice licenses constant 3 multiplying Jacob hourly pay. Computed Jake hourly pay multiplies daily hours, then computed daily pay multiplies days.
Jane gift plus extra yields James gift. Original nested subtraction removes both from initial apples. Desired retained count subtracts from the computed remaining stock.
Tissues per box times boxes yields purchased stock; subtract stated usage from the computed stock.
Quarter counts use their respective purchase inputs; both divisors are constant four quarters/dollar, including the one equal to the chip-count input. Sum computed dollar costs.
Student and adult counts pair with their matching ticket prices; sum both computed revenues.
Children count times books each yields child-held total; add additional books brought by teacher.
Each daily baking rate multiplies the same duration. Sister daily unit is supplied by parallel wording and shared a-day description. Original nested sum combines three computed outputs.
Shirt price multiplies shirt count; computed shirt subtotal plus total pants cost gives spending. Intermediate 60 is a prior result rather than a unit conversion constant.
Table A plus excess yields C. C is reused to compute A+C and twice C for B. Sum these computed subtotals. Time-of-day numbers and table count are irrelevant distractors.

Both equal-valued daily swimming durations occur once. Two programs differ only in direct addition order. Computed daily hours multiply school days; add weekend hours and multiply computed weekly total by weeks.

limitations: Source semantics reviewed by root with original TRAIN rationale; no independent held-out accuracy claim.
Fixed original calculator graphs preserve original structural unrolling and normalized unit numerators; this is not arbitrary question-counterfactual completeness.
Original value-only 354/7473 versus 1000 gate remains rejected.
Passing this pilot permits only a separately frozen expansion/training experiment; no current fitting, CAL, DEV or runtime promotion.
